main.description: When this account is generally free: a usual week of half-hour blocks in a home timezone, plus dated ranges when they are away. One record per account, rkey `self`.

timezone.description: IANA zone every HH:MM below is read in.

note.description: Shown to anyone reading the record.

validUntil.description: After this the record is stale and should be read as unknown, not empty.

alias.description: The short name this account claimed under sez.letsmeet.lol, if any. The app's own table is what makes it unique; this records what the owner chose.

block.description: A usually-free stretch on one weekday. `end` at or before `start` means the block runs past midnight.

away.description: An inclusive date range the account is not free, all day unless startTime/endTime narrow it to a window on each day.

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`, on or after start.
